topic: Coding Agent Debug Logs Guide 2026: Claude Code, Codex, GitHub MCP, and Playwright MCP

debugLogs.doctorCommand: Run `/doctor` inside Claude Code or `claude doctor` from shell for automated health check of installation, settings, MCP config, and context usage.
debugLogs.heapdump: Run `/heapdump` to write a JavaScript heap snapshot and memory breakdown to ~/Desktop (or home dir on Linux). Open .heapsnapshot in Chrome DevTools → Memory → Load.
debugLogs.safeMode: Run `claude --safe-mode` to disable all customizations (plugins, MCP servers, hooks) and check if performance issues are caused by them.
debugLogs.compactCommand: Run `/compact` regularly to reduce context size. Use `/compact keep only the plan and the diff` to focus compaction.
debugLogs.resumeSession: Run `claude --resume` in the same directory to pick up a previous session after a crash or restart.
debugLogs.clearCommand: Run `/clear` if earlier conversation is no longer needed.
debugLogs.feedbackCommand: Use `/feedback` within Claude Code to report problems directly to Anthropic.

solutions: For thrashing: read large files in chunks, use subagents, or /clear
For garbled text: run /terminal-setup or set terminal.integrated.gpuAcceleration to off
For search issues: install ripgrep and set USE_BUILTIN_RIPGREP=0

keyFeatures.claudeDotMd: CLAUDE.md files for project-level coding standards, architecture decisions, and preferences.
keyFeatures.autoMemory: Automatic memory building across sessions (build commands, debugging insights).
keyFeatures.hooks: Shell commands before/after actions (auto-format, lint before commit).
keyFeatures.subAgents: Spawn multiple agents for parallel work on different parts of a task.
keyFeatures.agentSDK: Build custom agents with Claude Code's tools and capabilities.
keyFeatures.scheduling: Run Claude on a schedule for recurring tasks (morning PR reviews, CI analysis).
keyFeatures.remoteControl: Move sessions between terminal, desktop, web, and mobile.
keyFeatures.teleport: `claude --teleport` to pull a session from another device.

debugLogs.logDir: Directory where Codex writes log files; defaults to $CODEX_HOME/log. Setting this explicitly also enables the opt-in plaintext TUI log, codex-tui.log.
debugLogs.authCache: Login details cached locally in a plaintext file. Tokens refresh automatically during use.
debugLogs.forcedLoginMethod: Can enforce ChatGPT-only or API-key-only login via forced_login_method config.
debugLogs.mcpServers: MCP servers configured under [mcp_servers.<id>] with command, args, and env settings.
debugLogs.bearerTokenEnvVar: Environment variable sourcing the bearer token for MCP HTTP servers via mcp_servers.<id>.bearer_token_env_var.

troubleshooting.authIssues: MFA required for email/password login. Social login providers (Google, Microsoft, Apple) don't require MFA. Login caching in plaintext file.
troubleshooting.mcpOAuth: Optional fixed port for MCP OAuth callback server. Optional base callback URL override for devbox ingress.
troubleshooting.loginShell: allow_login_shell config for shell-based tools to use login-shell semantics.
troubleshooting.snapshotShell: Snapshot shell environment to speed up repeated commands (on by default).

keyFeatures.installation: curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | sh (Mac/Linux) or npm install -g @openai/codex or brew install --cask codex.
keyFeatures.auth: Sign in with ChatGPT (recommended) or API key. Supports Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, Enterprise plans.
keyFeatures.mcpSupport: Full MCP server support with stdio and HTTP transports, OAuth login, environment variable forwarding.
keyFeatures.configLayers: Supports user, project, session, and managed hooks config layers.
keyFeatures.lifecycleHooks: allow_managed_hooks_only in requirements.toml for admin-controlled hooks.

debugLogs.errorHandling: Custom error handling with GitHubAPIError and GitHubGraphQLError types. Errors stored in context for middleware inspection.

errorTypes.GitHubAPIError: Used for REST API errors. Contains Message, Response (*github.Response), and Err fields.
errorTypes.GitHubGraphQLError: Used for GraphQL API errors. Contains Message and Err fields.

errorResponseFunctions: ghErrors.NewGitHubAPIErrorResponse(ctx, message, response, err) — for REST API errors
ghErrors.NewGitHubGraphQLErrorResponse(ctx, message, err) — for GraphQL API errors
debugLogs.contextManagement: Errors stored in context via errors.ContextWithGitHubErrors(ctx) and retrieved via errors.GetGitHubAPIErrors(ctx) / errors.GetGitHubGraphQLErrors(ctx).
designPrinciples: User-actionable errors (auth failures, rate limits, 404s) → failed tool calls
Developer errors (JSON marshaling, internal logic) → Go errors that bubble up through MCP framework

troubleshooting.remoteServer: Hosted at https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/. Supports OAuth and PAT authentication.
troubleshooting.localServer: Docker image at ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server. Supports OAuth login with browser flow or device-code fallback.
authMethods: GitHub Personal Access Token (GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var)
troubleshooting.enterpriseSupport: GitHub Enterprise Server: use --gh-host flag with https:// prefix. ghe.com: use https://YOURSUBDOMAIN.ghe.com.
troubleshooting.patSecurity: Minimum scopes: repo, read:packages, read:org. Store in env vars or .env file, never commit.
troubleshooting.insidersMode: Early access to new features via URL path /insiders or X-MCP-Insiders header.

keyFeatures.toolsets: Configurable toolset selection. Default toolsets used when none specified.
keyFeatures.hostIntegration: Supports VS Code, Claude Desktop, Claude Code CLI, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed, JetBrains, and more.
keyFeatures.streamableHttp: Supports streamable HTTP transport for remote server.

debugLogs.consoleLevel: --console-level <level> or PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CONSOLE_LEVEL env var. Values: error, warning, info, debug. Each level includes more severe levels.
debugLogs.outputMode: --output-mode <mode> or PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_OUTPUT_MODE env var. Values: 'file' or 'stdout'. Default: stdout.
debugLogs.outputDir: --output-dir <path> or PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR env var. Directory for output files.
debugLogs.outputMaxSize: --output-max-size <bytes> or PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_OUTPUT_MAX_SIZE env var. Threshold for evicting old output files.
debugLogs.saveSession: --save-session or PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_SAVE_SESSION env var. Save session into output directory.
debugLogs.browserTracing: browser_start_tracing and browser_stop_tracing tools for trace recording.
debugLogs.browserDebugging: browser_pause and browser_resume tools for step-by-step debugging. browser_resume with step=true pauses before next action.
debugLogs.browserSetDebugger: browser_set_debugger tool to pause at specific <file>:<line> location.
debugLogs.snapshotMode: --snapshot-mode <mode> (full/none). Default: full. Controls whether accessibility snapshots are returned.
debugLogs.imageResponses: --image-responses <mode> (allow/omit). Controls whether image data is sent in responses.
debugLogs.caps: --caps <caps> comma-separated: vision, pdf, devtools. Enables additional capabilities.
debugLogs.cdpEndpoint: --cdp-endpoint <endpoint> for connecting to Chrome DevTools Protocol.
debugLogs.sharedBrowserContext: --shared-browser-context to reuse browser context across HTTP clients.

troubleshooting.headlessMode: --headless flag or PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_HEADLESS env var. Headed by default.
troubleshooting.sandbox: --no-sandbox to disable sandbox, --sandbox to enable. For containerized environments.
troubleshooting.persistentProfile: Session data stored at platform-specific location. Override with --user-data-dir.
troubleshooting.isolatedMode: --isolated flag to keep browser profile in memory only (no disk save).
troubleshooting.extension: Chrome Extension for connecting to existing browser tabs and logged-in sessions.
troubleshooting.allowedHosts: --allowed-hosts <hosts> or PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS. Restrict which hosts the server serves.
troubleshooting.allowedOrigins: --allowed-origins <origins> or PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS. Trusted origins for browser requests.
troubleshooting.blockedOrigins: --blocked-origins <origins> or PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_BLOCKED_ORIGINS. Blocked origins (evaluated before allowlist).
troubleshooting.initPage: --init-page <path> for TypeScript file evaluated on Playwright page object.

keyFeatures.cliVsMcp: CLI+SKILLS recommended for coding agents (more token-efficient). MCP for specialized agentic loops (exploratory automation, self-healing tests, long-running workflows).
keyFeatures.accessibilityTree: Uses Playwright's accessibility tree, not pixel-based input. No vision models needed.
keyFeatures.deterministic: Deterministic tool application avoids ambiguity of screenshot-based approaches.
keyFeatures.imageResponses: --image-responses <mode> (allow/omit) for controlling image data in responses.

commonDebugPatterns: All four tools support environment variable configuration for debug/log levels.
Claude Code and Codex CLI both have built-in doctor/health-check commands.
GitHub MCP and Playwright MCP both support structured error handling and tracing.
All tools support MCP protocol for tool integration.
Claude Code and Codex CLI both support session persistence and resume after crash.

uniqueFeatures.claudeCode: Heap dump analysis, auto-compaction, safe mode, /doctor command, CLAUDE.md project config, skills system, hooks, sub-agents, scheduling, teleport.
uniqueFeatures.codexCli: TOML config, log_dir with plaintext TUI log, MCP OAuth with fixed port, login shell semantics, snapshot shell, managed hooks.
uniqueFeatures.githubMcp: Custom error types with context middleware, OAuth/PAT/GitHub App auth, remote and local deployment, insiders mode, enterprise support.
uniqueFeatures.playwrightMcp: Console level filtering, output mode (file/stdout), browser tracing, step-by-step debugging, accessibility tree (no vision), headless/headed modes, persistent profiles, CDP endpoint integration, snapshot mode control, image response control, shared browser context, storage state, secrets file, test ID attribute, action timeout, code generation, device emulation, init scripts, Chrome Extension integration, sandbox control, proxy support, HTTPS error bypass.

targetAudience: Developers and DevOps engineers using AI coding agents who need to debug issues with Claude Code, Codex CLI, GitHub MCP Server, and Playwright MCP Server in 2026.
contentGaps: No single comprehensive guide covering debug logs across all four tools exists — this brief fills that gap.
Claude Code's debug configuration page (docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/debug-configuration) is a Next.js app — content not accessible via plain HTTP fetch.
Codex CLI's official docs (developers.openai.com/codex) are an Astro SPA — requires JavaScript rendering for full content.
GitHub MCP Server has no dedicated troubleshooting.md — error handling is documented in code patterns (error-handling.md).
Playwright MCP Server has no dedicated troubleshooting docs — debug features are embedded in CLI flags and env vars (comprehensive list now captured).
Claude Code docs moved to platform.claude.com domain — old docs.anthropic.com URLs may redirect or require JS.
